title: Psionic shortcuts tested on program members, including children

tellings.quote: There are cheats and some of the cheats that have been experimented with are things that have not fared well for those involved in the program including children

plain: A secret program has tested "cheats", meaning shortcuts to psionic abilities (powers of the mind), on its own members, and some of them, children included, have been harmed by it. That is the claim of Jake Barber, a guest who says he used his helicopter to retrieve a UFO, and he repeats it as something he was told: "some of the cheats that have been experimented with are things that have not fared well for those involved in the program including children."
